theme: 3 terms on app images: the home screen picture, the Xcode image folder, and the entry with several sizes

terms.definition: The picture that represents your app on the Home Screen and in the App Store.
terms.example: Designers sent the new App Icon this morning.

terms.definition: A folder in Xcode that stores your images, colors and icons.
terms.example: Put the new logo in the Asset Catalog, not in the project folder.

terms.definition: One named entry that holds the same picture in several sizes, such as 1x, 2x and 3x.
terms.example: Make an Image Set so the picture stays sharp on every device.
terms.code:
// Avatar has 1x, 2x and 3x files
imageView.image = UIImage(named: "Avatar")

video.title: App Icon, Asset Catalog & Image Set | Day 120
video.description:
Learn to explain how iOS apps store images and icons: App Icon, Asset Catalog & Image Set, with real code, a quiz at the end and each example read twice (normal, then slow).

Today's terms
App Icon - The picture that represents your app on the Home Screen and in the App Store.
Asset Catalog - A folder in Xcode that stores your images, colors and icons.
Image Set - One named entry that holds the same picture in several sizes, such as 1x, 2x and 3x.

Quiz at the end - write your answers in the comments, then watch again to check.

Day 120 of the iOS Daily English series: 3 terms a day, from Swift basics to advanced iOS.

landscape.title: iOS App Icon, Asset Catalog & Image Set | Day 120
landscape.description:
Explain App Icon, Asset Catalog & Image Set in iOS by listening to a real code chat between two iOS devs.
앱 아이콘, 에셋 카탈로그, 이미지 세트 표현을 영어 대화로 익혀요.

App Icon - The picture that represents your app on the Home Screen and in the App Store.
한국어: 앱 아이콘: 홈 화면과 앱스토어에서 앱을 나타내는 그림

Asset Catalog - A folder in Xcode that stores your images, colors and icons.
한국어: 에셋 카탈로그: 이미지, 색, 아이콘을 보관하는 Xcode 폴더

Image Set - One named entry that holds the same picture in several sizes, such as 1x, 2x and 3x.
한국어: 이미지 세트: 1x, 2x, 3x처럼 같은 그림을 여러 크기로 담은 항목

In this video, Mina and Jake add a new logo and a dark app icon, in a chat-style conversation, with the Swift code on screen.
Mina와 Jake의 채팅 스타일 대화와 화면 속 Swift 코드로 배워요.

landscape.hook: Can you explain App Icon, Asset Catalog and Image Set in English?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Jake, where should I put the new logo?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: In the Asset Catalog. Then load it with `UIImage(named:)`.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Make an Image Set. It holds the 1x, 2x and 3x versions.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: What if the Image Set has only one big file?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Then iOS scales it, but it may look soft.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Okay. And the new App Icon?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: The App Icon also lives in the Asset Catalog.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Can users choose a dark App Icon?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yes, call `setAlternateIconName` with the name, like Dark.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Do I need to add that icon somewhere first?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yes, add it to the Asset Catalog, then build again.
The new App Icon looks great on the Home Screen.
